inherited_context.description: Where each field the records inherit is declared, once per table, before writing records (rule INHERITED CONTEXT IS DECLARED ONCE). scope table = one value for the whole table, written here with page, place and the printed words; per_column = each columns[] entry holds its own; per_row = it varies by row and goes in each record's treatment or record field; as_trial = the trials[] value holds (inoculation only); not_printed = searched in header, caption, footnotes, methods and text and not there, with pages_read; not_applicable. Checked on one sample record per table (end_checklist.inheritance_samples).

unit.description: Unit of the cells. per_column when columns differ (the usual for a table of several variables); table when every column shares one printed unit ('sacas de 60 kg/ha', 'Valores em %').

value.description: The table-wide unit as printed. Null unless scope is table.

source_page.description: PDF page where the table-wide value is printed. Null unless scope is table (or as_trial with a value, then the trial's page).

source_place.description: Where on that page. Null unless source_page is filled.

evidence_quote.description: The printed words that say it, at most 15, exactly as printed (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Null unless source_page is filled.

pages_read.description: Pages read when the answer is not_printed: header, caption, footnotes, methods and text of those pages were searched (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Empty otherwise.

unit_basis.description: Basis of the unit (rule YIELD UNIT AND ITS BASIS): per what and what product. table when one basis holds for every quantity column ('café beneficiado por hectare' in the caption); per_column when columns differ; not_printed when no header, caption, footnote, methods or text says it; not_applicable when the table has no product quantities (scores, %, chemistry).

value.description: The table-wide basis as printed. Null unless scope is table.

source_page.description: PDF page where the table-wide value is printed. Null unless scope is table (or as_trial with a value, then the trial's page).

source_place.description: Where on that page. Null unless source_page is filled.

evidence_quote.description: The printed words that say it, at most 15, exactly as printed (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Null unless source_page is filled.

pages_read.description: Pages read when the answer is not_printed: header, caption, footnotes, methods and text of those pages were searched (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Empty otherwise.

statistic.description: What the cells are. It mirrors table_level_labels.statistic: table when that holds for every column, per_column when some columns say otherwise in columns[].statistic.

value.description: The table-wide statistic, same as table_level_labels.statistic. Null when scope is per_column.

source_page.description: PDF page where the table-wide value is printed. Null unless scope is table (or as_trial with a value, then the trial's page).

source_place.description: Where on that page. Null unless source_page is filled.

evidence_quote.description: The printed words that say it, at most 15, exactly as printed (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Null unless source_page is filled.

pages_read.description: Pages read when the answer is not_printed: header, caption, footnotes, methods and text of those pages were searched (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Empty otherwise.

crop_stage.description: When the cells were measured within a season. table only when one printed time holds for every column ('em maio de 2004', in the caption); per_column otherwise; per_row when the rows are evaluation dates; not_printed when no column has a time; not_applicable for a table with no time.

value.description: The table-wide time as printed. Null unless scope is table.

source_page.description: PDF page where the table-wide value is printed. Null unless scope is table (or as_trial with a value, then the trial's page).

source_place.description: Where on that page. Null unless source_page is filled.

evidence_quote.description: The printed words that say it, at most 15, exactly as printed (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Null unless source_page is filled.

pages_read.description: Pages read when the answer is not_printed: header, caption, footnotes, methods and text of those pages were searched (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Empty otherwise.

harvest_year.description: Which harvest the cells belong to (rule HARVEST YEAR, PER COLUMN, AS PRINTED). table when one printed harvest holds for every column and no column prints its own; per_column when columns are harvest years or print their own; per_row when the rows are years; not_printed; not_applicable for laboratory, nursery and post-harvest tables with no named harvest.

value.description: The table-wide harvest as printed. Null unless scope is table.

source_page.description: PDF page where the table-wide value is printed. Null unless scope is table (or as_trial with a value, then the trial's page).

source_place.description: Where on that page. Null unless source_page is filled.

evidence_quote.description: The printed words that say it, at most 15, exactly as printed (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Null unless source_page is filled.

pages_read.description: Pages read when the answer is not_printed: header, caption, footnotes, methods and text of those pages were searched (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Empty otherwise.

biotic_target.description: What the cells are about. table when every column takes one target (a table of % bored fruits of a berry borer trial); per_column when columns differ.

value.description: The table-wide target from the biotic_target enum. Null when scope is per_column.

source_page.description: PDF page where the table-wide value is printed. Null unless scope is table (or as_trial with a value, then the trial's page).

source_place.description: Where on that page. Null unless source_page is filled.

evidence_quote.description: The printed words that say it, at most 15, exactly as printed (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Null unless source_page is filled.

pages_read.description: Pages read when the answer is not_printed: header, caption, footnotes, methods and text of those pages were searched (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Empty otherwise.

pathogen_inoculation.description: Pathogen inoculation or pest infestation of the plants or units of this table. as_trial = trials[].inoculation_or_infestation holds for every row; per_row = it is a factor (inoculated and non-inoculated rows), part of each record's treatment; not_applicable = none.

value.description: Table-wide inoculation as written, only when it differs from the trial (scope table). Null otherwise.

source_page.description: PDF page where the table-wide value is printed. Null unless scope is table (or as_trial with a value, then the trial's page).

source_place.description: Where on that page. Null unless source_page is filled.

evidence_quote.description: The printed words that say it, at most 15, exactly as printed (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Null unless source_page is filled.

pages_read.description: Pages read when the answer is not_printed: header, caption, footnotes, methods and text of those pages were searched (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Empty otherwise.

status.description: filled = value found and written; not_printed = searched the whole document (methods, captions, footnotes, text) and it is not there; not_applicable = the field does not apply (dose for a cultivar trial, spray volume for a fertilizer trial, uniform_sprays when the sprays are the treatment, planting_date_or_age for a laboratory assay on unnamed plants, harvest_years_covered for a nursery trial).

page.description: PDF page where the value was found. Null unless status = filled.

status.description: filled = the document says it and table_level_labels holds it; not_printed = caption, footnotes, methods and text searched and it is not there; not_applicable = the table has no letters, no scores or no transformation.

page.description: PDF page where it is printed. Null unless status = filled.

context.description: One entry per trial and per context field in the enum.

footnotes.description: One entry per results, figure_labeled or text table and per label.

table_footnotes.description: Every footnote and note of every results, figure_labeled or text entry, with the columns it went into (rule UNIT FROM HEADER, CAPTION, FOOTNOTES AND METHODS).

rows.description: One entry per results, figure_labeled or text table: the axes and the row_identity counts against the records.

columns.description: One entry per results, figure_labeled or text table: the columns[] counts against the records, and the columns whose labels differ from the table.

column_answers.description: One entry per column of every results, figure_labeled or text entry (rule WHEN IT WAS MEASURED, rule HARVEST YEAR, PER COLUMN, AS PRINTED and rule TARGET OF THE TRIAL, AND OF EVERY COLUMN), each with its quote and page or the pages read (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES).

inheritance_samples.description: One entry per results, figure_labeled or text entry: its first record with every inherited field resolved, quoted and checked on the page (rule ONE SAMPLE RECORD PER TABLE).

doses.description: One entry per trial that has product, fertilizer or input treatments with a dose, or uniform sprays (rules DOSE RESOLVED PER TREATMENT, DOSE IN BOTH FORMS, COUNT THE APPLICATIONS, ONE INCLUDED, UNIFORM SPRAYS ARE CONTEXT).

targets.description: One entry per trial (rule TARGET OF THE TRIAL).

transcribed.description: Sum of tables[].transcribed. Must equal records.

skipped_cells.description: Sum of tables[].skipped_cells. data_cells = transcribed + skipped_cells.

every_table_closes.description: true only when every tables[] entry has data_cells = transcribed + skipped_cells and transcribed equal to its records.

doc_id.description: Document id from sources.json (also the PDF file name without .pdf).

trial_id.description: trial_id of the trials[] entry this value belongs to. Must be one of its table's trial_ids; when the table has one, it is that one.

table_id.description: table_id of the tables[] entry this value was read from. Its table_level_labels apply to this record.

column_id.description: column_id of the columns[] entry of this record's table. The column's variable, unit, stage, statistic, transformation and target apply to this record.

page.description: PDF page number, counted from 1. Same as the page of the table_id entry.

table_or_figure.description: Label as printed ('Tabela 3', 'Quadro 1', 'Figura 2'), or 'text'. Same as the label of the table_id entry.

treatment.description: Row label exactly as printed in that table (cultivar, progeny code, product, dose, spacing, water regime, drying yard, 'Testemunha', 'Média'), footnote markers included; with the stub's dose joined by ' - ' when the stub prints it (rule ROW IDENTITY). For a factorial cell, and for a column that is a level of a treatment factor, the levels joined with ' x ' in the table's order ('Catuaí Vermelho IAC 144 x com nematicida', 'com zinco x 10-3 M').

treatment_code.description: Code printed in the row ('T3', '1', 'H 419-3-3-7-16-4-1', 'clone 02'), as written, following table_level_labels.row_identity. A released cultivar's name with its line number ('Catuaí Vermelho IAC 144', 'BRS 1216') is not a code; an ordinal number before a name is not a code. Null only when the row prints no code.

treatment_type.description: Null = as table_level_labels.treatment_type, for ordinary rows only. Every row listed in row_identity.special_rows carries its class here, even when it looks obvious (Testemunha is control, a Média over two factors is combination, a program row in a table of single fungicides is spray_program), and every record of a main-effects-only table carries the class of its factor.

is_marginal.description: true for marginal means or totals printed in the table (Média row or column), and for every record of a table with row_identity.axes.main_effects_only = true.

cultivar.description: Coffee cultivar of this record as written, only when it varies inside the trial and the row or the key gives a name (rule ROW IDENTITY). A progeny, line or clone known only by its code leaves this null (the code is in treatment_code). Null when trials[].cultivar applies.

active_ingredient_or_input.description: Product, organism, fertilizer source or input of this treatment in the fixed form of rule FIXED FORM FOR PRODUCT AND DOSE: active ingredient first, commercial name in parentheses ('fipronil (Klap 200 SC)', 'endosulfam (Thiodan 350 CE)', 'Beauveria bassiana (Boveriol)', 'oxicloreto de cobre', 'ureia', 'sulfato de zinco'), taken from the treatment table or methods when the results table gives a code. Tank mixtures joined with ' + ', alternated products with ', '; the way of applying never here. Only what this treatment received; never a uniform spray, never a post-harvest treatment (rule POST-HARVEST IS THE TREATMENT). Null for checks, genotypes and non-product treatments.

dose_and_unit.description: Dose of this treatment only, resolved from the treatment table or methods (rules DOSE RESOLVED PER TREATMENT and DOSE IN BOTH FORMS), as 'value unit' per product in the order of active_ingredient_or_input, '; ' between commercial-product and active-ingredient doses when both are printed ('0,1 L p.c./ha; 25 g i.a./ha', '400 kg/ha de N'). Never the spray volume, never a uniform spray. Null only for checks, non-product treatments or when printed nowhere.

dose_source_page.description: PDF page where the dose is printed; when the two forms come from different places, the page of the treatment table. Null when dose_and_unit is null.

application_stages.description: Timing of this treatment, only when it differs from trials[].application_stages ('em novembro e janeiro', 'três vezes, de outubro a dezembro'), in our own words when long. Never the pathogen inoculation timing, never a uniform spray. Null when the trial value applies.

n_applications.description: Number of applications of this treatment when it differs from the trial: printed as a number, counted from the treatment table or calendar, or 1 for a single application said in the methods (rule COUNT THE APPLICATIONS, ONE INCLUDED); and 0 for an untreated check in a trial whose treated plots have a count (rule CHECK AND n_applications). Never counts pathogen inoculations, uniform sprays or post-harvest operations. Null otherwise.

crop_stage.description: Null = as the column (columns[].crop_stage). Filled only when this one cell has its own time, different from its column, or when inherited_context.crop_stage is per_row. Never invented: rule NEVER INVENT A STAGE. Never a harvest year.

crop_stage_refers_to.description: Null = as the column. Filled together with a record-level crop_stage.

harvest_year.description: Null = as the column (columns[].harvest_year), then as the table (inherited_context.harvest_year). Filled only when this cell has its own harvest, different from its column, or when inherited_context.harvest_year is per_row (rows that are years), or when the year of the column and the month or date of the row combine ('junho de 2004'). As printed, never computed (rule HARVEST YEAR, PER COLUMN, AS PRINTED).

biotic_target.description: Null = as the column (columns[].biotic_target). Filled only when this row measures something else than its column says.

variable.description: Null = the column header (columns[].header_as_printed). Filled only when a cell needs its own wording: a split column ('RG / PH' split in two records), or a transposed table read cell by cell.

variable_standardized.description: Null = as the column. Filled only together with a record-level variable. Vocabulary, defined in rule COFFEE VARIABLES. Yield: yield_bags_ha (sacas/ha as printed), yield_mass_area (kg/ha, t/ha, kg/1000 covas, kg/parcela), yield_per_plant, yield_volume (litres of fresh fruit), with the product form in unit_basis; relative_yield_pct; yield_loss_or_gain; outturn_ratio ('rendimento' as fruit to processed coffee); fruit_ripeness_pct (% cherry, green, overripe or dry fruits, class in class_label); productive_branch_trait (nodes per branch, fruits per node). Beans and cup: bean_size_sieve_pct (sieve in class_label); peaberry_pct (moca); bean_mass (100 or 1000 beans); bean_defects (defects, type); bean_physical (colour, density, moisture); bean_chemistry (acidity, soluble solids, electrical conductivity, potassium leaching, caffeine, sugars); cup_score (total); cup_attribute_score (one attribute); cup_class (beverage class, value_kind class); seed_germination_pct; seed_vigor; drying_measure (drying time, moisture or temperature during drying). Disease, with the disease in biotic_target: rust_incidence_pct (% leaves with rust); disease_incidence_pct (% leaves, fruits or plants with another disease); disease_severity_pct (% lesioned area, any disease); disease_score; disease_index; disease_audpc; disease_reaction_class; reaction_class_share_pct; disease_component (latent and incubation period, sporulation, lesions); defoliation_pct; diseased_plant_count; pathogen_in_vitro; pathogen_population. Pests, with the pest in biotic_target: berry_borer_infestation_pct (% bored fruits); leaf_miner_infestation_pct (% leaves with mines); leaf_miner_mines (mines per leaf, mines preyed); pest_density (other pests per unit); pest_infestation_pct (other pests, % units); pest_damage_pct; pest_damage_other; trap_catch; pest_mortality_pct; control_efficacy_pct (statistic relative_to_check); predation (prey eaten, prey stage in organism_stage); natural_enemy_measure; pest_biology; pest_reaction_class; nematode_measure. Plant: stand_or_survival; phenology (flowering events, days, ripening cycle); plant_trait (height, canopy and stem diameter, branches, shoots); plant_vigor_score; plant_biomass; leaf_area; leaf_nutrient (leaf pair and month in crop_stage); nutrient_use_efficiency; optimum_dose; plant_water_physiology; water_use. Soil and other: soil_chemistry and soil_physical after the treatments; soil_biology; phytotoxicity; weed_measure; cover_crop_measure; microclimate; economic; sample_size (rule SAMPLE SIZE IS DATA); other (say what in notes; should stay under 1%).

value_kind.description: numeric for every number; class for reaction classes, category lists, traces ('Tr') and dates printed as values; illegible for a data cell that cannot be read with confidence (value null, doubt in notes).

value.description: The number from the cell, decimal point. Null only when value_kind is class or illegible. Only changes allowed vs value_as_printed: decimal comma to point, removal of thousands separators, dropping a leading zero. A sign printed or stated for parentheses is kept (rule PRINTED SIGNS).

value_as_printed.description: The cell exactly as printed, without letters, asterisks, footnote markers or dispersion term ('2.920', '45,3', '(26,91)', '05', 'Tr', 'MS', '9/set'). The best reading or '' when value_kind is illegible.

dispersion_as_printed.description: Dispersion term attached to this value as printed ('± 0,3', '(2,1)', a standard error printed next to the mean). Null if none.

unit.description: Null = as the column (columns[].unit), then as the table (inherited_context.unit). Filled only when this cell prints its own unit.

unit_basis.description: Null = as the column (columns[].unit_basis), then as the table (inherited_context.unit_basis). Filled only when this cell prints its own basis.

statistic.description: Null = as the column, then as the table. Filled only when this row differs from both ('Média' row in a table of single values, a 'Total' row).

statistic_stated.description: Null = as the column, then as the table. Filled only together with a record-level statistic.

significance_letter.description: Letter(s) or asterisk(s) printed with the value, exactly as printed ('a', 'AB', 'a A', 'bc', '*', '**', 'n.s.' when printed on the value). What they mean goes once in table_level_labels.letters_meaning. Null if none.

transformation_stated.description: Null = as the column, then as the table. Filled only when this cell states its own transformation.

source_inconsistency.description: Conflict about this value only (text vs table for this cell), with both versions and pages. Conflicts about the whole table or trial go there, not here. Null otherwise.

notes.description: What the checker needs: page of the treatment key for coded rows, footnote marker on the value, the way of applying, the reason a label is overridden, the spray volume when it varies by treatment, the quoted sentence for 'text' values (at most 15 words), reading doubts. Never a value that should be its own record.

records_with_treatment_code.description: Records of this table with treatment_code not null.

records_with_name.description: Records of this table with cultivar or active_ingredient_or_input not null.

records_marginal.description: Records of this table with is_marginal = true. Equals records when main_effects_only is true.

records_of_special_rows.description: Records whose treatment is one of row_identity.special_rows.

records_of_special_rows_with_type.description: Records of special rows that carry treatment_type explicitly. Must equal records_of_special_rows.

rows_match.description: true only when every record of a coded row has treatment_code, every record of a named row has its name, every record of a special row carries its class explicitly, and records_marginal = records when main_effects_only is true.

column_id.description: Short id unique inside the table: 'c1', 'c2', ... in printed order. One entry per measured column; when the table is printed transposed (variables as rows), one entry per variable row. A column that repeats under each trial block ('Safra 1 / Safra 2') is one entry per block.

header_as_printed.description: Column header exactly as printed, joined with ' / ' from the top header down ('Produtividade (sc/ha) / 2001', 'Porcentagem de frutos broqueados / 30 DAA', 'Terreiro híbrido / Cereja'). This is the record's variable unless the record says otherwise.

variable_standardized.description: Standardized variable of this column (same enum as the record). Inherited by every record of the column.

unit.description: Unit as printed for this column in the header, caption, footnotes, methods or text ('sacas/ha', 'kg/1000 covas', '%', 'minas/folha', 'g/kg', 'mL NaOH 0,1 N/100 g', 'pontos'), read from wherever it is printed (rule UNIT FROM HEADER, CAPTION, FOOTNOTES AND METHODS), with unit_source_place and unit_source_page saying where. Null if none printed anywhere, or when inherited_context.unit is table (then the table holds it).

unit_source_place.description: Where the unit was read: header, caption, footnote, methods, text, or not_printed when it is printed nowhere. Methods count: a yield column headed 'Produtividade' whose unit is only in the methods ('expressa em t/ha') takes it from there.

unit_source_page.description: PDF page where the unit was read. Null when the unit is null.

unit_quote.description: The printed words that give the unit and its basis, at most 15 (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Null when the unit is null.

unit_basis.description: Basis of the unit, as printed (rule YIELD UNIT AND ITS BASIS): per what (hectare, plant, plot, 1000 holes, leaf) and what product (café beneficiado, em coco, cereja, da roça, verde), in the document's words joined with '; ' ('por hectare; café beneficiado', 'por 1000 covas; café em coco seco', 'por planta; café da roça'). 'not_printed' when header, caption, footnotes, methods and text say neither. Null for columns that are not quantities of a product (scores, %, chemistry) and when inherited_context.unit_basis is table.

organism_stage.description: Pest or predator stage counted in this column: egg, larva, protonymph, deutonymph (mites), nymph, pupa, adult, mixed (all stages together), not_applicable (disease, yield, bean, cup and plant columns). In a predation table the prey stage. Null when the column counts an organism and the document does not say the stage.

plant_part.description: Where a disease, pest, damage, nutrient or trait column was measured: leaves (not specified, or a leaf pair, which goes in crop_stage or notes), leaves_middle_third, leaves_upper_third, leaves_lower_third (the third of the canopy the leaves came from, when printed), branches (plagiotropic branches), orthotropic_stem (main stem, stems), canopy (the whole foliage rated together), flowers, fruits (cherries, fruits on the plant or harvested, bored fruits), beans (green processed coffee: sieve, defects, chemistry), beverage (cup scores and classes), roots (nematodes, root mass), seedling (nursery plants measured whole), whole_plant, plot (rated per plot or area). not_applicable for yield, economic, soil and weather-like columns. Null when a disease or pest column does not print the organ.

factor_level.description: When the columns are levels of a treatment factor (row_identity.axes.column_axis_kind = treatment_factor), the level this column holds as printed ('Com nematicida', 'Sem nematicida', 'Pleno sol', 'Sombreado', 'Adensado'), joined to each record's treatment. Null otherwise.

class_label.description: Class of this column as printed, with its limits when printed: sieve ('peneira 16 e acima', 'peneira 13'), fruit ripeness class ('cereja', 'verde', 'passa', 'seco ou bóia'), defect or cup class, reaction class of a class-share column. Required when row_identity.axes.column_axis_kind is classes; null otherwise.

crop_stage.description: When this column was measured within a season, as printed in its header, the caption, a footnote, the methods or the text ('30 DAA', 'em maio de 2004', 'folhas do terceiro par em dezembro', 'colheita em junho', 'após 72 h de secagem'), with crop_stage_quote. Filled only for a column whose time the document prints; null with crop_stage_status not_printed (pages_read filled) or not_applicable. Yield and bean columns take a harvest stage only when the harvest is printed with a date, month, day count or ripeness stage (rule NEVER INVENT A STAGE). Never a harvest year.

crop_stage_refers_to.description: What crop_stage counts from or means: harvest = measured at harvest, only when the document prints the harvest with a date, a month, a day count or a ripeness stage ('colheita em junho de 2004', 'quando 80% dos frutos estavam maduros'); evaluation = a rating date or month not tied to an event ('em maio de 2004', 'avaliações mensais'); growth_stage = a phenological stage named ('pré-florada', 'chumbinho', 'granação', 'maturação'); application = days after a spray or an application (DAA); planting = days or months after planting or transplanting; pruning = after stumping or pruning; flowering = days after the main flowering; inoculation = days after inoculation of a pathogen; infestation = days or hours after infestation or release of a pest or predator; drying = hours or days of drying; storage = days or months of storage; other. The harvest year is never here (harvest_year). Null only when crop_stage is null.

crop_stage_source_page.description: PDF page where crop_stage was read. Null only when crop_stage is null.

crop_stage_source_place.description: Where the time was read: header, caption, footnote, methods, text. Null only when crop_stage is null.

crop_stage_status.description: filled = crop_stage holds the printed time; not_printed = header, caption, footnotes, methods and text searched and the time of this column is nowhere; not_applicable = the column has no time (a lab assay with no age, a class list, an economic column). Never left out.

crop_stage_quote.description: The printed words that give the time, at most 15 (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Null unless crop_stage_status is filled.

harvest_year.description: Harvest this column belongs to, exactly as printed ('2001', 'safra 76/77', '1º biênio', '98+99', 'média de nove colheitas (1994-2002)'), from header, caption, footnotes, methods or text (rule HARVEST YEAR, PER COLUMN, AS PRINTED). Null with harvest_year_status not_printed or not_applicable, or when inherited_context.harvest_year is table or per_row.

harvest_year_status.description: filled = harvest_year holds the printed harvest; inherited = inherited_context.harvest_year is table or per_row; not_printed = searched and not there (pages_read); not_applicable = laboratory, nursery or post-harvest column with no named harvest. Never left out.

harvest_year_source_page.description: PDF page where the harvest was read. Null unless harvest_year_status is filled.

harvest_year_source_place.description: Where on that page. Null unless harvest_year_status is filled.

harvest_year_quote.description: The printed words that give the harvest, at most 15. Null unless harvest_year_status is filled.

pages_read.description: Pages searched for this column's time, harvest, unit or basis when any of them is not_printed (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). Empty when all were found or do not apply.

statistic.description: Null = as table_level_labels.statistic. Filled when this column differs ('Total' column in a table of means, an efficacy column in a table of counts is relative_to_check).

statistic_stated.description: Null = as the table. Filled together with a column-level statistic, or when the column carries its own footnote saying what it is.

transformation_stated.description: Transformation stated for this column only ('dados transformados em raiz de x + 0,5' on the count columns, none on yield). Null = as table_level_labels.transformation_stated.

biotic_target.description: Pest, disease or disorder this column measures (% leaves with rust is coffee_leaf_rust, % bored fruits is coffee_berry_borer, mines per leaf is coffee_leaf_miner, prey eaten by phytoseiids is red_mite when the prey is Oligonychus ilicis, galls are nematodes). For yield, outturn, bean and economic columns, the trial's target (rule TARGET OF THE TRIAL, AND OF EVERY COLUMN), never none when the trial rates a pest or disease; plant traits, leaf nutrients, cup and post-harvest quality of a trial without pests are none. Inherited by every record of the column.

notes.description: Formula of an efficacy, relative or difference column, whether 'rendimento' is yield or outturn and why, what a header abbreviation means and the page of its key, what a dispersion term is, a transformation; at most 15 words quoted. Null otherwise.

columns_stage_not_applicable.description: Columns with crop_stage_status not_applicable. The three counts add up to columns.

columns_harvest_year_not_applicable.description: Columns with harvest_year_status not_applicable. The four counts add up to columns.

columns_harvest_stage.description: Columns with crop_stage_refers_to harvest. Each one has a printed harvest date, day count or stage in crop_stage (rule NEVER INVENT A STAGE).

columns_unit_from_methods_or_text.description: Columns whose unit_source_place is methods or text.

columns_unit_not_printed.description: Columns with unit_source_place not_printed. Each was searched in header, caption, footnotes, methods and text.

columns_with_unit_basis.description: Columns with unit_basis filled, or covered by inherited_context.unit_basis scope table.

methods_searched.description: true when the methods and the text were read for the unit, its basis, the time and the harvest of every column, one column at a time (end_checklist.column_answers), not only the header and footnotes.

columns_differing_from_table.description: column_ids whose statistic, statistic_stated or transformation_stated differ from the table and are written on the column.

records_with_valid_column.description: Records of this table whose column_id is one of the table's columns. Must equal records.

columns_match.description: true only when the three stage counts and the four harvest-year counts each add up to columns, every record has a valid column_id, methods_searched is true and every harvest-stage column prints the harvest.

marker.description: The footnote marker as printed ('1', '(2)', 'a', '*', 'Tr'), or 'caption' or 'note' for a note printed above or below the table without a marker.

content_kind.description: What the footnote gives (inoculation = pathogen inoculation or pest infestation of the plants).

summary.description: What it says, in our own words or at most 15 words quoted.

applied_to.description: column_ids it went into, 'table' when it went to table_level_labels, 'trial' when it went to trials[], 'none' when it holds nothing for the values (say why in summary).

dose_source_pages.description: Pages where the doses of this trial are printed.

product_treatments.description: Treatments of this trial that received a product, fertilizer or input with a dose (checks excluded).

records_with_product.description: Records of this trial with active_ingredient_or_input not null.

records_with_dose.description: Records of this trial with dose_and_unit not null.

multi_dose_cells.description: Cells of a treatment table or methods list that hold the doses of several treatments, or several doses of one product used by different treatments.

multi_dose_cells_resolved.description: Of those, how many were resolved so that each treatment's records carry only its own product and dose. Must equal multi_dose_cells.

both_forms_printed.description: true when the treatment table or methods print the dose of the products both as commercial product and as active ingredient (rule DOSE IN BOTH FORMS).

records_with_both_forms.description: Records of this trial whose dose_and_unit holds both forms. Equals records_with_dose when both_forms_printed is true.

application_count_source.description: Where n_applications of this trial comes from: printed = a number in the text or table; counted_from_design = counted from a treatment table or calendar, a fertilizer split, or a single application said in the methods (rule COUNT THE APPLICATIONS, ONE INCLUDED); varies_by_treatment_counted = each treatment counted on its records; not_printed = no number, no countable list and no single application said; not_applicable = no applied treatments.

spray_volume_kept_out.description: true when no dose_and_unit of this trial contains the spray volume.

uniform_sprays_kept_out.description: true when no record of this trial carries a uniform spray in active_ingredient_or_input, dose_and_unit, application_stages or n_applications (rule UNIFORM SPRAYS ARE CONTEXT).

doses_match.description: true only when every record of a product treatment has its product and its own dose (or the dose is printed nowhere for it), multi_dose_cells_resolved = multi_dose_cells, both forms are carried when printed, spray_volume_kept_out and uniform_sprays_kept_out are true, and application_count_source is not counted_from_design with records left without their count.

damage_or_disease_rated.description: Does the document rate any pest, disease, damage or disorder in this trial (% leaves with rust, % bored fruits, mines, mites, galls, defoliation by disease, scores)? Plant traits, nutrients and cup or bean quality rated as traits do not count.

rated_targets.description: The targets rated in this trial, from the biotic_target enum. Empty when nothing is rated.

rated_pages.description: Pages where those ratings are printed.

trial_biotic_target.description: trials[].biotic_target as written. Not none when damage_or_disease_rated is true.

production_columns.description: Columns of this trial that measure yield, outturn, beans, plant or economics rather than a pest or disease.

production_columns_with_trial_target.description: Of those, how many carry the trial's target in columns[].biotic_target. Must equal production_columns.

targets_match.description: true only when trial_biotic_target is not none whenever damage_or_disease_rated is true, and production_columns_with_trial_target = production_columns.

methods_say_when.description: Do the methods or the text say when this variable was measured (days after an application, a month, a stage, a harvest with date or month, readings every week or month, 'ao final')? Read for this column, not borrowed from another variable's calendar.

methods_quote.description: When methods_say_when is true: the words that say it, at most 15, exactly as printed. Null otherwise.

methods_page.description: Page of methods_quote. Null when methods_say_when is false.

pages_read.description: When methods_say_when is false: every page of methods and text that was read for it. Empty otherwise.

harvest_year_printed.description: Do the header, caption, footnotes, methods or text name the harvest of this column?

measures_damage_or_pest.description: Does this column measure damage, a pest, a disease or a disorder (% leaves with rust, % bored fruits, mines, mites, galls, defoliation by disease)? Plant traits, nutrients, yield, cup and bean quality do not.

answers_match.description: true only when crop_stage_status is filled whenever methods_say_when is true, harvest_year_status is filled or inherited whenever harvest_year_printed is true, and biotic_target is not none whenever measures_damage_or_pest is true.

record_index.description: Position in records[] (from 0) of the sample: the first record of the table.

trial_id.description: trial_id of the sample record, checked against the column block it was printed in.

treatment.description: treatment of the sample record, checked against the printed row.

unit.description: Effective unit after inheritance. Null when not printed or not applicable.

unit_basis.description: Effective unit_basis after inheritance. Null when not printed or not applicable.

statistic.description: Effective statistic after inheritance. Null when not printed or not applicable.

crop_stage.description: Effective crop_stage after inheritance. Null when not printed or not applicable.

harvest_year.description: Effective harvest_year after inheritance. Null when not printed or not applicable.

pathogen_inoculation.description: Effective pathogen_inoculation after inheritance. Null when not printed or not applicable.

evidence.description: One entry per inherited field: the page and the printed words that give its effective value, or the pages read when it is not printed (rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES). A field that is not_applicable has quote null and pages_read empty.

quote.description: At most 15 words, exactly as printed.

checked_page.description: PDF page of the cell reread for the check.

matches_print.description: true only when every resolved value above agrees with the print for that cell and with the quoted words.

fix_applied.description: What was wrong and which declaration was fixed (column, table or trial), in a few words. Null when matches_print was true at the first check.

second_sample_index.description: Position in records[] of the second sample (the last record of the table), checked after a fix. Null when no fix was needed.

changes_from_caupi_v9: Coffee is perennial: the harvests of one planting are one trial. New column_axis_kind harvest_years, new harvest_year on columns, records and inherited_context, and trials[].harvest_years_covered. Means and sums of harvests are marginal columns of the same trial, not joint analyses. Rule TRIALS FIRST, rule HARVEST YEAR, PER COLUMN, AS PRINTED and rule MARGINAL ROWS AND COLUMNS. The year of a harvest never goes in crop_stage (rule NEVER INVENT A STAGE).

Yield basis declared once: new unit_basis on columns and in inherited_context (per hectare, plant, plot or 1000 holes; beneficiado, em coco, cereja or da roça), from cowpea RODADA 'base da unidade' (fazolin1986, cardoso1997), and the coffee trap of 'rendimento' meaning outturn. Rule YIELD UNIT AND ITS BASIS.

Evidence, not a yes: inherited_context entries with scope table, every column's crop_stage, harvest_year and unit, every column answer and every sample check carry a quote of at most 15 words and its page, or the pages read when the answer is not_printed. From cowpea RODADA: the 592 column answers and 132 samples all said 'confere' and missed the four measuring-time cascades. Rule EVIDENCE, NOT A YES.
Measuring time in the methods with the cowpea closed examples barreto1999 (weekly readings) and andrade2002 (end of cycle), and fishing bergamin2011 and lima2016. Rule WHEN IT WAS MEASURED.

Block without number both ways: a block with its own place or year line is its own table (cowpea cardoso1981); a run of rows under the same header is not (cowpea gualter2011). Rule BLOCK WITHOUT NUMBER, BOTH WAYS.

Post-harvest and storage are the treatment, never an application (cowpea sousa2021, 146 records). New treatment types harvest_method, post_harvest_processing, drying, storage. Rule POST-HARVEST IS THE TREATMENT.

Comparison against a treatment that is not the check: statistic 'difference' (new enum value), the row is the cultivar and the comparator goes in variable (cowpea gualter2011). Rules on relative values and TEXT VALUES.
Marginal label as printed ('Média', 'X', 'Total'), never standardized (cowpea cardoso1997). Rule MARGINAL ROWS AND COLUMNS.

Cell-level period: year in the column and month in the row combine per record; a caption's range goes only to a column that pools it (health iversson1976). Count columns need their counted thing as unit (fishing round). An 'N=' in the stub is data (health santos1995). Rule HARVEST YEAR, rule UNIT FROM HEADER and rule SAMPLE SIZE IS DATA.
Fitted values from the authors' regression are skipped cells (rule STATISTICS ARE NOT DATA).

Rhizobial inoculation removed (no use in coffee): trials[].rhizobial_inoculation, inherited_context.rhizobial_inoculation and its rule are gone. New trial fields coffee_species, planting_date_or_age and harvest_years_covered; sowing_date became planting_date_or_age. Rule PLANTATION CONTEXT.

Vocabulary for coffee: yield_bags_ha, yield_mass_area, yield_per_plant, yield_volume, outturn_ratio, fruit_ripeness_pct, productive_branch_trait, bean_size_sieve_pct, peaberry_pct, bean_mass, bean_defects, bean_physical, bean_chemistry, cup_score, cup_attribute_score, cup_class, drying_measure, rust_incidence_pct, defoliation_pct and diseased_plant_count (from cowpea RODADA), berry_borer_infestation_pct, leaf_miner_infestation_pct, leaf_miner_mines, predation, leaf_nutrient, plant_vigor_score, cover_crop_measure, microclimate. seeds_per_plant from the cowpea list has no coffee use. Targets, treatment types, stages, plant parts and environments for coffee.
